## The measured numbers (host: macOS 14.4 arm64, Apple M3 Pro 12-core;
rustc 1.94.1 · Python 3.14.8 · node v25.2.1)

- **M-S2-5:** E1-alone clean build+test **457.462 s** (127.035 build +
  330.427 test). Pairs: **E1+E2 = 1.0006×, E1+E3 = 1.0027×** of
  E1-alone — the ≤1.5× score-5 bound met by a wide margin (the foreign
  legs add ≈0.28 s / ≈1.24 s serial time; interpreter trees carry no
  second compile toolchain).
- **M-S2-3:** far-side parse+rehash per frame sits in the
  10²–10⁴ µs band at both sizes on both toolchains (medians; whole
  six-frame arm ≈10.8 ms E2 / ≈111.8 ms E3).
- **M-S2-7:** hash-equality 100 % (57/57 E3; 49/49 covered E2).
- **Re-derived C12 (E5a) = 5 vs assumed 2** — |Δ| = 3, outside ±1,
  *favorable*: the assumed penalty overstated the polyglot cost.
- **Trigger 5 verdict (from the numbers):** the band check fires upward
  on the incumbent; the frozen-weight steps-5–7 substitution only
  strengthens E5a → **the decision HOLDS**. The C12
  `unmeasured-by-spike` mark is cleared — the polyglot conjunct is
  measured. E5b/E5c kernel-side CI pairs are recorded as
  not-buildable-in-tree (candidate ids only, CC4), never extrapolated.
